build.scope: SHA256 of actual HTTP response bytes, checked against the frozen local production build before timed browser work.

cpuScope: Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate(rate:4) applies to the page. The same-browser page/worker x1/x4/x1 calibration is recorded separately in ../cpu-scope-calibration.json. Worker-backed timings must be interpreted using that observed scope, not as a globally slowed machine. The sampled-main control separates same-thread reduction from off-thread placement. No low-end-device extrapolation is asserted.
memoryScope: V8 total includes measured page+dedicated-worker JS heap and backing stores after explicit GC in both contexts; excludes native/GPU allocations. RSS sums renderer processes in an isolated one-page browser and may include spare renderers; browser/GPU/utility processes are excluded. RSS is an approximation of tab footprint, not the browser Task Manager private-memory number.
fixtureScope: Controlled 900px uPlot loss plot. Baseline retains 32 MB canonical data and renders one million copied values; sampled-main retains the same canonical source and samples loss on the x4 main thread; optimized uses the actual worker API returning all three metric viewports on a normally scheduled worker. All use the same deterministic million-point source and observed 9.4 spike. Synthetic benchmark.hover is not used: actual trusted CDP mouse events are timed in-page.
applicationScope: Actual production React route, all three metrics at 1440x1000. First render: navigation start to all three actual drawn domains, no update overlays and fonts loaded plus two animation frames. Zoom: actual capture-phase trusted click to URL/new domain + no update overlays + two animation frames. Hover: actual trusted mousemove to changed tooltip + settled + two animation frames. Playwright transport is outside measured input spans. 5 cold-browser samples and 15 zoom/hover observations are a small bounded sample, not an SLA; reported nearest-rankP95 is descriptive, not a stable population tail.
traceScope: The first repetition per fixture mode/application is traced; subsequent repetitions omit tracing overhead and remain labeled by traceFile:null. The representative trace and numeric observations must not be treated as identical instrumentation. All modes use this same schedule; all repetitions retain raw numeric observations. Warm file/network cache and artificial localhost do not model deployment latency. Old evidence/performance remains unchanged.

attributedMemory.scope: Single observed overview in a fresh browser. Main frame and data worker are attributed through actual trace frame/worker metadata; PIDs are deduplicated. MemoryInfra process_totals.private_footprint_bytes is summed only for those renderer processes. Spare renderers, browser, GPU and utility processes are excluded. This is stronger renderer-private footprint attribution, not a claim to account for all shared browser/GPU resources or every byte a Task Manager might assign to a tab.
